faq: Can you work on code someone else wrote?
Yes. We read the code first and tell you what we find, including anything risky. If the code is hard to change, we say so before work starts and agree on the safest route with you.
What do you need to get started?
The source files or a repository invite, a list of the features you want, and a note on how the extension is used today. Screenshots of the screen you want changed help a lot.
Will a new feature need new permissions?
Sometimes. Extra permissions can trigger a fresh review and warn existing users, so we avoid them where we can and tell you clearly whenever a change needs one.
Do you publish the new version for me?
We prepare the package and update notes. If you add us to your developer account, we can upload it. Otherwise you upload it yourself in a couple of minutes.
